source.measurement: Native macOS ARM64 CI release executable and binary-only tar.gz; fork release archive independently checksummed. The embedded Web client and explicit HTTP/WebSocket runtime increase the native artifact by about 1.41 MB versus fork-1.0.99-9f6ce76; retain the existing 5% warning and 10% block thresholds.

Native macOS ARM64 CI release executable and binary-only tar.gz from the previous published fork-1.0.99-d55175a; its separate public release archive was independently checksummed. Refresh the cumulative baseline after remote ownership, terminal appearance and Web additions. The agent navigation/mobile candidate adds 16,736 executable bytes (+0.11%) and 15,392 archive bytes (+0.24%) versus this release, with no dependency changes. Retain the 5% warning and 10% block thresholds.
